title: Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Fundamentals
overview: This certification is an opportunity to demonstrate your knowledge of core data concepts and related Microsoft Azure data services. As a candidate for this exam, you should have familiarity with Exam DP-900’s self-paced or instructor-led learning material.
eligibility: None strictly required. Prior knowledge of Microsoft cloud technologies recommended.
exam_format_type: Multiple choice, case studies, and performance-based labs
testing_method: Pearson VUE testing center or online proctored
